doc: Side area of dungeon d03 on a condor's nest, where Max and Monica learn Spheda. The condor is blocked from her chicks by a time distortion, so Monica teaches the player to hit the Sphere fragment into it with a stick (events 308 to 317). The script also contains the full Spheda shot physics and the prizes, ending with Mrs. Condor giving the White Windflower.
